subject: Weekly MAP Checkpoint — Trial Acceptance Gatewalk
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly MAP Checkpoint — Trial Acceptance Gatewalk

Hi Sam / Jenna,

Following up for our weekly MAP checkpoint. Attaching the acceptance matrix and the updated MAP timeline for visibility (attached: acceptance_matrix_v1.xlsx, map_timeline_v2.pdf). Primary goals for this update:

- Quick status recap against acceptance criteria (pass/partial/fail)
- Call out blockers that would impact close timeline
- Confirm owners and next actions for this week

Agenda (15 min):
1) Eval plan progress: sample workload results, latency & throughput targets
2) Acceptance criteria: pass conditions and outstanding items
3) Blockers: data access, SOC2 evidence, model perf variance
4) Next steps and sign-off path

Current snapshot (high level):
- Eval plan: in progress — model throughput tests complete for 8k tokens, sample latency within 95th percentile target but token accuracy drift observed on a subset of queries.
- Acceptance criteria: 6/9 checks green, 2/9 partial, 1/9 blocked (audit logs availability).
- Blockers: we still need a final SOC2 evidence bundle and a reproducible sample for the quantized 7B model regression.

Action items I expect to confirm in this thread:
- Karthik: triage perf drift and provide perf logs + mitigation plan (ETA 3 business days)
- Ben: coordinate with Acme infra to enable audit-log export for the trial environment (owner: Ben; ETA 48 hours)
- Marissa: update MAP timeline with revised acceptance dates after we close the audit-log item (owner: Marissa; ETA EOD Thu)

Can you confirm availability for a short sign-off call on Fri (Apr 30) if these items close?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 415-555-0203

Attachments: acceptance_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), map_timeline_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@acme-retail.com>

Cc: Jenna Liu <jenna.liu@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP Checkpoint — Trial Acceptance Gatewalk

Thanks Stephanie — useful summary. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- We can run a broader sample workload on Thurs morning but need the exact test harness config (batch sizes, prompt set) from your side. Will you share the harness?
- SOC2 package: our security ops require the SOC2 summary + control mappings for the inference runtime (they asked specifically about audit-log retention and access controls). If Redwood can share the SOC2 extract or pointer to the evidence, that would speed validation.

We should also avoid changing quantization settings mid-trial; if your team needs to test a different quantization profile, we prefer that to be done on a shadow environment rather than our trial instance.

Happy to take the sign-off Fri if the audit/log item is resolved.

—Sam
Sam Torres
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Acme Retail
sam.torres@acme-retail.com
Phone: +1 212-555-3309

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP Checkpoint — Trial Acceptance Gatewalk

On the perf regression: I pulled the perf logs and ran a comparison across the 7B quantized variant versus the baseline FP16 run. Early observations:

- There is a small but consistent increase in perplexity on prompts that include long-form product catalogs (~1.8% drift).
- 95th percentile latency remains within the target window; tail tokens are slightly noisier under long sequences.

Attached the raw logs and a short notes file (perf_logs_0428.zip) — key next steps I recommend:
1) Re-run quantized build with updated kernel flags (we have a branch queued) — ETA 3 business days to validate and produce a regression-proofed artifact.
2) Create a targeted prompt set (subset of catalog queries) to reproduce the drift deterministically — Karthik owner (ETA: Thu EOD).
3) If regression persists, fallback to the non-quantized variant for Acme's trial to avoid impacting acceptance criteria while we iterate.

I agree we should not flip quantization on the customer's live trial instance. We'll stage changes in shadow. I will post the test harness config in the shared Drive link and ping Marissa when done.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff ML Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: perf_logs_0428.zip (logs)

Subject: Re: Weekly MAP Checkpoint — Trial Acceptance Gatewalk

Thanks Sam / Karthik — summarizing and locking owners/dates here so we have a clear walk path to sign-off: 

Meeting notes (short):
- Acceptance matrix: 6 green, 2 partial, 1 blocked (audit logs). We need audit export and the quantization reproduction to close the remaining items.
- Eval plan: performance tests run; regression observed on long-form catalog prompts. We will reproduce offline and push a non-disruptive fix.

Updated action items (owners & deadlines):
- Ben Carter: Coordinate with Acme infra to enable audit-log export and share a sample export with Redwood (owner: Ben Carter; ETA: 48 hours — EOD Thu Apr 30).
- Karthik Iyer: Complete targeted reproduction (prompt subset) and validate kernel flag branch on shadow environment (owner: Karthik Iyer; ETA: 3 business days — Wed May 1).
- Marissa Cole: Update MAP timeline and reflect conditional sign-off path (owner: Marissa Cole; ETA: EOD Thu Apr 30).
- Stephanie Nguyen: Prepare sign-off checklist and call invite for Fri Apr 30 11:00am PT if items close (owner: Stephanie; ETA: Fri Apr 30 morning).

Risks / mitigation:
- If audit logs are delayed >48 hours, sign-off will slip by at least one week. Mitigation: Ben to request temporary read-only access to the trial instance logs and provide a sanitized sample.
- If quantization fix is slower than expected, we'll propose using the FP16 variant for the remainder of the trial to preserve acceptance gating.

Can the Acme team confirm Ben's access plan and whether Fri 11:00am PT works as a tentative sign-off time?

Thanks,
Stephanie
